{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|arg= global

|gr1= Vehicle Inventory

|descr= Returns all items names and count from ammo box (or any general weapon holder container).

|s1= [[getItemCargo]] box

|p1= box: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Array]] with [classes, counts]
* classes: [[Array]] of [[String]]s - Item class names
* counts: [[Array]] of [[Number]]s - Item counts

|x1= <sqf>
getItemCargo cursorTarget;
/*
	returns e.g
	[
        ["5ItemA", "10ItemB"]
        [5, 10]
	]
*/
</sqf>

|seealso= [[itemCargo]] [[addItemCargo]] [[addItemCargoGlobal]] [[clearItemCargo]] [[clearItemCargoGlobal]]
}}
